prompt:
Analyze this Neural View implementation and provide specific UX/UI improvement recommendations:

CURRENT NEURAL VIEW FEATURES:
- Physics-based force-directed graph visualization
- Real-time neural network simulation with play/pause controls
- Interactive nodes with drag-and-drop functionality
- Multiple visualization modes (network, heatmap, graph)
- Connection lines showing file relationships
- Neural metrics display (density, connection strength, pattern recognition)
- Help overlay with usage instructions
- Canvas-based rendering with performance optimization
- Node clustering based on file relationships
- Hover states and selection highlighting

TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION:
- Canvas 2D rendering with requestAnimationFrame
- Force-directed graph physics simulation
- Node positioning algorithms with clustering
- Real-time interaction handling (drag, hover, click)
- Performance monitoring (FPS, processing time)
- Responsive canvas sizing
- Error handling and loading states

CURRENT UX ISSUES TO ADDRESS:
- Visual clarity and node distinction
- Performance with large datasets
- Mobile touch interactions
- Accessibility for screen readers
- Color contrast and visual hierarchy
- Zoom and pan controls
- Node labeling and information display
- Connection line visual overload

Provide 3-5 specific, actionable improvements focusing on:
1. Visual clarity and information hierarchy
2. Performance optimization for large datasets
3. Mobile experience and touch interactions
4. Accessibility and screen reader support
5. Interactive controls and zoom functionality

Keep response concise and implementation-focused.
